column1: # Executable-code span locality per corpus ROM, measured 2026-08-05.
# Produced by examples/probe_code_span_locality.rs. Clusters JR RA
# (0x03e00008) sites into spans, splitting on gaps > 0x40000, and reports
# what fraction of them fall in the largest span.
# WHY THIS IS WORTH RECORDING ONCE: DiscoveryStrategy::BootBankOnly
# (lib.rs:885) is a single verdict covering both 'this ROM has no overlays,
# nothing to find' and 'this ROM has overlays we failed to find'. This is a
# PERMANENT property of the ROM, so it separates the two:
#   NO_CANDIDATES and genuinely MULTI_SPAN         21  <- real misses
# The remaining overlay-discovery gap is therefore ~21 ROMs, not 229.
